rules.source: Ley No. 172-13 sobre Protección de Datos Personales — https://presidencia.gob.do/sites/default/files/statics/transparencia/marco-legal/leyes/Ley-172-13.pdf
rules.retrieved_snippet: Objective: comprehensive protection of personal data in files/public registries/data banks, public or private, guaranteeing the right to honor and privacy under Article 44 of the Dominican Constitution. Published in Official Gazette No. 10737, 2013-12-15.

rules.source: Ley No. 136-03, Código para el Sistema de Protección y los Derechos Fundamentales de Niños, Niñas y Adolescentes — https://www.dgjp.gob.do/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/Ley-Nu%CC%81m.-136-03.pdf
rules.retrieved_snippet: The State is responsible for protecting children and adolescents against all forms of abuse, mistreatment and exploitation regardless of medium, including internet/electronic means; dissemination of images/data that could affect physical, psychological or moral development is prohibited.

rules.source: Procuraduría General de la República Dominicana — Ley 136-03 — https://pgr.gob.do/wpfd_file/ley-no-136-06/
rules.retrieved_snippet: Exposure and revictimization of children/adolescents in media is penalized under Ley 136-03; sanctions (fines and prison) established in Articles 394-411 of the Code.

rules.source: Ley General de Protección de los Derechos del Consumidor o Usuario, Ley 358-05 — https://proconsumidor.gob.do/historia/
rules.retrieved_snippet: Establishes the regime for defense of consumer/user rights, guaranteeing equity and legal security between suppliers and consumers. Enacted 2005-09-09; Article 33 recognizes rights to life/health/safety protection and truthful, clear, timely information. Enforced by Pro Consumidor.
